Full-yard landscape design and build in Boynton Beach

We design your yard in 3D before we plant a thing — then our own crew builds the pavers, beds and poolside gardens you walked through on screen.

See the work Call us

We treat every yard as a design problem first — resolved on screen, then built by the same hands that drew it.

Root Wise is a design-build landscape studio on the Palm Beach coast. Most of our work starts the same way: a walk of your property, then a 3D mockup so you can see the finished front or backyard before anything is planted or poured.

From there we build it ourselves — paver patios and walkways, tropical planting beds, river-rock borders and poolside gardens — and we can keep it flourishing with a seasonal refresh once it's in.

How we work

From a walk of the yard to a space you live in

01

Walk your property

We start on site — how you use the yard, what stays, what the light and drainage will allow.

02

Design it in 3D

You get a 3D mockup and a plant plan, so you can see the finished yard before we break ground.

03

Build it ourselves

The same team installs the pavers, beds and features — clean, on schedule, and true to the design.

04

Keep it flourishing

An optional seasonal refresh keeps everything healthy and looking the way it did on day one.
